title: First open-source firmware for AM5 officially launches — Dasharo v0.9.0 brings Coreboot and openSIL to Zen 4 APUs on MSI B850
summary: Firmware development company 3mdeb has officially launched the first open-source UEFI firmware for AMD's AM5 platform. The firmware is built on Coreboot and AMD's openSIL, the latter being AMD’s new open-source firmware framework.
